flow.pages: GENERAL MASTER (State, Zone, City, District, Location, Commodity, Package, Designation …) and MASTER (Branch, Vendor, Market Vendor, Vehicle, Driver, Client, Consignor / Consignee, Employee, Accounts, Rates)
flow.what: Entered first; every other page takes its names and codes from here. A record that is missing can be added from the drop-down itself ("+ New …"), for users who have access to that master.
Staff logins and their menus (rights). At login the user picks the division, financial year and branch.

flow.pages: General Rate Master, Client Contract, ODA Charge, PRS / DRS Rate Master
flow.what: Standard tariff, each client's contract rates (slabs, charges, KM, category), ODA charges and what pickup / delivery vehicles are paid.
A consignment is booked: consignor, consignee, weight, packets, invoices. Rate and charges come from the contract; the server recomputes GST and totals.
Pickup run sheet: which staff collects which dockets from the consignor.

flow.pages: Loading Sheet, Manifest Entry / List, bag labels
flow.what: Dockets lying at the branch put on a loading sheet (optional), then grouped in a manifest to another branch — from the loading sheet or directly. Courier divisions bag them in the same save (tick / scan dockets → Make bag, tick bags → Make master bag; optional packets and Auto bag; barcode labels); TMS divisions (cargo / FTL) manifest whole dockets in one entry.
Manifests loaded on a vehicle: vehicle, vendor, freight; posts an accounts entry.
Goods reach the destination branch; packets and weight are checked.
Dockets handed to the delivery staff.
Delivered / undelivered — door delivery via DRS or godown delivery.

flow.pages: POD Dispatch, POD Courier, POD Receive
flow.what: Signed POD images sent with an IOM; couriered to head office and received there.
Every step of a docket in one place; booking register.

flow.pages: Client Bill, Paid / To Pay bill, Misc / Warehouse / Octroi bills, Vendor invoice
flow.what: Client bills from delivered dockets and contract rates; finalise, submit, receive.

flow.pages: Account Master, Contra, Payment (bill-wise), Books & Reports (Day Book, Ledger, Trial Balance, P&L, Balance Sheet)
flow.what: Every rupee accounted for: challan freight, bills, receipts, payments; next: receipt / journal vouchers, GST reports, salary.

flow.pages: Destination / franchisee bindings, docket stock (shippers), approvals, FY change, effective dates, ODA config, vendor vehicles, MIS mail
flow.what: The rules and stock the other screens run on: which branch delivers where, docket-number books, discount and margin approvals, year-end moves.
